The longest I’ve had to wait for an appointment was 2 weeks and that’s only because I was away on holiday myself for 1 of those 2 weeks.

My chronic illness is handled with empathy and with detailed explanations. Where I’ve been made to feel like a burden and not receiving good care at previous practices, I always feel heard and taken care of here even if my symptoms feel silly to explain, at times.

Lovely reception staff, especially the man (don’t know his name, sorry), who is so lovely and speaks so gently and kindly to everyone.

My toddler absolutely loves Dr Thornton Smith, who is great with kids. He actually asks me often when we can go to the doctor!

The facilities are bright and spacious. It doesn’t feel depressing visiting this practice. There is a pharmacy on site too and ample parking so very convenient.

Thank you Arundel Surgery staff!",null,[0,208]]]],[null,1743152402000000,1743152402000000,"11 months
